A lone armored paladin makes a desperate last stand on a rise, his holy light a tiny defiance against the endless dead.
A vast bone-dragon rears up behind the lich, wings of stretched bone unfurling against the blood-moon.
A captured soul writhes and glows within a floating crystal cage at the necromancer's side.
A cracked hero's statue lies toppled and shattered, its noble face half-buried in ashen earth.
A blood-moon hangs enormous and low, its red light drowning the battlefield in the color of open wounds.
A flight of spectral ravens spirals overhead, their translucent wings leaving faint trails of cold light.
A stone sarcophagus splits wide, disgorging a cascade of skeletal hands clawing upward through the rubble.
A glowing phylactery pulses on a black altar, its sickly light the beating heart of the necromancer's power.
A living captive hangs bound in chains above a ritual circle, struggling against the inevitable sacrifice below.
A swirling portal tears open in the earth, violet and black, exhaling cold mist and half-formed shades.
Ghostly chains erupt from the ground, coiling around fleeing soldiers and dragging them slowly, screaming, downward.
A second bone-dragon circles low and hungry behind the first, doubling the dread weight of the scene.
A holy banner burns in a dead knight's fist, its white flame the last ember of resistance.
Shattered cathedral arches frame the necromancer, their carved saints defaced and crowned with skulls.
A river of grave-light bleeds upward from the mass graves, feeding the dark ritual in rolling waves.
A knight's ghost, still armored, fights its own risen corpse in a silent, agonizing struggle nearby.
A second portal yawns open above the first, raining skeletal warriors like dark hail onto the field.
A child's broken doll lies trampled in the foreground, innocence crushed beneath the tide of death.
A shattered crown rests half-buried in mud, its gems dark, the fallen kingdom wordlessly mourned.
An enormous obsidian throne rises from the ground as the ritual deepens, built from the bones of kings.
A burning siege tower collapses in the background, its silhouette swallowed by smoke and circling wraiths.
A bound angel kneels chained at the necromancer's feet, its light flickering, its wings pinned and broken.
A dozen spectral wolves race ahead of the undead host, their hollow eyes burning with cold hunger.
A dying mage presses his last spell into a rune etched on the ground, buying seconds with his life.
A second phylactery shatters mid-air, releasing a screaming soul upward, a rare moment of terrible freedom.
